body:
BOMBER
CR 6

XP 2,400
N Medium humanoid
Init +2, Senses Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 39 (6d6 +18) (30 hp strings)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 45 ft.
Melee slam +12 (1d4+2 bludgeoning plus grab)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 15, Con 16, Int -, Wis -, Cha –
Base Atk +6; CMB +8 (+14 grapple), CMD 20

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Grab (Ex)

The bomber makes a grapple check against creatures it hits. Creatures grabbed by the bomber do not get a save when it detonates.

Single-Minded (Ex)

These creatures do not s pea k. They do not understand language. They only try to grab living targets other than themselves.

Detonate (Ex)

Upon death or if a bomber starts its turn with a grabbed creature, it will detonate. All creatures other than other bombers within a 10-foot radius suffer 8d6 force damage. A Reflex save DC 17 is given to cut this damage in half.
